Select drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID as indication_curie, EFO term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind from molecule_dictionary joined to drug_indication on molregno. Filter to approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
